method_performed.name: Analytical enumeration for bounded 2-variable budget/effectiveness ILP. Iterate X from 0 to 5000; for each X compute minimum feasible integer Y = ceil(max(0, (10000-2X)/3)); check budget constraint Y <= 5000-X; track minimum cost. Uses cost-per-effectiveness insight (X=$5/pt < Y=$6.67/pt) but verifies via scan.
steps: For each X, compute minimum feasible Y = max(0, ceil((10000-2X)/3))
